description: This Java source file defines the security configuration for a Spring Boot web application using Spring Security 6. It sets up security rules to permit public access to certain endpoints (like API docs, Swagger UI, H2 console, and health checks), requires HTTP Basic authentication for all other endpoints, disables CSRF protection, and allows framing from the same origin for the H2 console.

classes.name: SecurityConfig
classes.description: Configuration class that sets up security rules for the application, including permit all for certain endpoints, HTTP Basic auth, disabling CSRF, and frame options for H2 console.

methods.name: securityFilterChain
methods.description: Defines the security filter chain, specifying headers, CSRF, authorization rules, HTTP Basic auth, and form login options.
